name: Southeastern Cable Contractors, Inc.
old_description: Throughout her career, Helena has led and supported major multi-million-dollar telecom projects for service providers, engineering firms, construction teams, and government partners. She specializes in project management, RDOF and BEAD initiatives, permitting strategy, operational optimization, and cross-functional leadership, helping organizations strengthen partnerships, improve efficiency, and successfully bring complex infrastructure projects from concept to completion.
about:
Based in Southport, North Carolina, Southeastern Cable Contractors, Inc. has spent nearly two decades building a reputation as a veteran-led broadband construction partner serving cable multiple-system operators and network providers across the Southeast.

The company delivers turnkey telecom and utility construction services spanning aerial, underground, and micro-trenching installation; fiber and coaxial deployment; permitting and engineering; MDU and ISP builds; and full project management with warehouse and inventory logistics. It reports millions of feet of subsidy-funded broadband construction completed and more than 5,000 miles of fiber built for government programs such as BEAD and RDOF, supported by a 70 percent in-house W-2 crew model and a fleet representing millions of dollars in equipment investment.

Customers include cable MSOs, internet service providers, and public-sector agencies pursuing federal broadband subsidies. The firm has executed residential drops, large-scale commercial builds, and government-funded infrastructure projects across multiple Southeastern states, with a documented 99.4 percent post-inspection pass rate and the ability to stand up new market branches within 30 to 60 days.

Southeastern Cable positions itself as a single-point accountability partner that lets MSOs focus on their core business rather than contractor oversight. Its stated differentiators include high-performance crews equipped for difficult projects, OSHA-compliant safety programs with weekly training and daily job-hazard analysis, and a philosophy of reliable execution backed by hands-on leadership.

name: Southern Maple Co
old_description: Mark has been studying and practicing the art of furniture making for 8 years. His work can be seen from CA to NY, as well as in businesses including the Omni Hotel and Able in Nashville, where he’s lived since 2009.
about:
Southern Maple Co operates from Nashville, Tennessee, where owner Randy Cuba established the business after relocating from his home state in 2015. Cuba's woodworking roots trace back to childhood projects with his father, whose tools he inherited and which sparked a deeper commitment to the craft. After honing his skills at the Fort Houston maker space, Cuba launched Southern Maple Co as a custom woodworking shop focused on furniture and cabinetry.

The company designs and builds heirloom-quality furniture and cabinets for residential and commercial clients. Work is performed in a Nashville shop where the team — including furniture maker Mark Shreve, who has eight years of experience and a portfolio that spans coast-to-coast installations — handles projects from concept through installation. Shreve's background includes pieces for the Omni Hotel and the Nashville venue Able, indicating a capacity for both one-off commissions and larger hospitality builds.

Clients range from homeowners seeking bespoke tables, bookcases, and built-ins to businesses needing custom millwork for hotels and restaurants. The firm emphasizes a collaborative process, keeping the client involved from initial design to final delivery. Past work includes sofa tables, bookcases, pallet walls, and hospitality furniture for venues in the Nashville area.

Cuba frames the business around translating a client's vision into a lasting piece, citing the personal satisfaction of bringing ideas to life as the core motivation. The shop's differentiator is presented as a hands-on, client-integrated workflow rather than volume production.

name: Southern Medical Corporation
old_description: SMC was founded in 1987 in response to a shortage of trained technologists able to perform competent cardiovascular services. SMC strives to provide a comprehensive range of products and services while maintaining an excellent reputation for quality
about:
Southern Medical Corporation was founded in 1987 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, in response to a shortage of trained technologists able to perform competent cardiovascular services. The company began as a provider of specialized technical staffing and services for the cardiovascular field.

Today, SMC delivers a range of technical, ultrasound, and nuclear services, along with biomedical resources and management consulting. The firm operates mobile ultrasound units across Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas, serving healthcare facilities with on-site imaging and diagnostic support.

Its customer base includes hospitals, clinics, and medical practices seeking cardiovascular and diagnostic services. Affiliates such as American Diagnostic Technologies and Etech Medical Solution extend its reach into equipment supply and specialized medical solutions.

The company emphasizes a comprehensive service portfolio and a reputation for quality and dependability, aiming to fill the gap in qualified cardiovascular technologists that prompted its founding.

name: Southern Metal Fabricators
old_description: Southern Metal Fabricators specializes in custom carbon steel and aluminum fabrication for industrial applications — platforms and handrails, bulk storage tanks and silos, hoppers, ductwork, conveyor structures, and material handling equipment. We build to spec, deliver on time, and have the time-earned experience to consult on your drawings before a single piece of metal is fabricated.
about:
Southern Metal Fabricators is based in Albertville, Alabama. The company was founded in 1991 by Charles Bailey as a two-man shop serving maintenance and light fabrication needs of local industry. It remains family-owned, with Bailey's sons Ashton and Whitton now involved in the business.

The company provides custom carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum fabrication for industrial applications. Its capabilities span design, cutting, forming, welding, finishing, and assembly, with in-house detailing using AutoCAD, MTC Shape Cutting, and Pro Nest software. The 130,000-square-foot high-bay production building sits on six acres of laydown yard and is served by four overhead cranes (up to 10 tons) and a 35-ton gantry crane, enabling fabrication of platforms, handrails, bulk storage tanks, silos, hoppers, ductwork, conveyor structures, and material handling equipment.

Southern Metal Fabricators serves a broad range of industries including agriculture, architecture, automotive, cement, construction, coal and biomass, egg and poultry, feed and grain, iron and steel, mining and quarry, marine, petroleum, paper, plastics, power generation, retail, utilities, and woodworking. Past projects include structural fabrication for ThyssenKrupp's steel manufacturing facility in Alabama.

The company emphasizes a "tool up to handle any custom metal fabrication job, start to finish, right here on the premises" philosophy. Differentiators include pre-assembly and test-running before shipping, a dedicated point of contact for the life of each project, and an in-house quality inspector overseeing every step.

name: Southern Motion
old_description: By Tara Hickock Bringing natural light into your home is a bright idea, both emotionally and economically. It can elevate your mood and help your house feel happier and more welcoming. Using the sun’s power can save you money by cutting down on your electricity bill. Use these home decorating tips to learn how to […]
about:
Southern Motion was founded in 1996 in Pontotoc, Mississippi, by Guy Lipscomb and his wife Sandy. The company took its name from a painting titled "Southern Motion" they encountered while shopping, which embodied the spirit of relaxation and comfort that would define their product line.

The company manufactures reclining furniture exclusively, including sofas, recliners, sectionals, and accent chairs with features such as power headrests, massage and heat, and wireless charging. Operations span five facilities in northern Mississippi, employing more than 1,500 workers. Southern Motion emphasizes domestic production, describing its products as American made with both domestic and imported parts.

Southern Motion sells through independent retailers across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. Its customer base consists of furniture retailers who carry the brand's motion furniture collections. The company does not sell directly to consumers but supports a network of retail partners.

Southern Motion positions itself as a leader in design and innovation within the motion furniture category, driven by a commitment to American manufacturing and a belief that domestic workers can produce quality, competitively priced products. The company also highlights its community involvement, including long-term support for the American Cancer Society's Relay for Life and other charitable initiatives.

name: Southern Packaging, LP
old_description: Join over 900 satisfied clients and browse our inventory of industrial bulk packaging products to find your perfect solution.
about:
Southern Packaging, LP was founded in 2004 in Venus, Texas, near the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. The company operates as a limited partnership and has grown into one of the largest distributors of bulk packaging supplies in North America.

The firm stocks more than 1,100 industrial packaging products — including flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBCs), FIBC liners, multi-wall paper bags, polyethylene bags, woven polypropylene bags, BOPP bags, UN-certified hazardous-material containers, bulk container liners, load-protection supplies, paperboard slip sheets, pallet covers, and stretch film. From its strategically located warehouses it ships to nearly 900 customer locations across the United States, reporting over 100 million bags shipped in 2025. Services include vendor-managed inventory programs, custom package design, and the sale of bag-filling equipment for powders, flakes, and granular products.

Southern Packaging serves manufacturers nationwide across sectors such as agriculture (deer corn and wildlife feed), chemicals (hazardous materials), and general dry-flowable product handling. Its customer base includes over 1,100 clients who rely on the company’s same-day shipping for in-stock items and its relationships with packaging manufacturers.

The company emphasizes its position as the largest on-demand inventory of FIBCs and multi-wall paper packaging in North America, backed by ISO 9001 certification, competitive pricing, and a commitment to reliable on-time delivery.

name: Southpaw Furniture Co
old_description: Solid hardwood furniture expertly handcrafted in our 5,000 sq ft workshop and delivered nationwide – our furniture is built to last a lifetime. If you are looking to make your house feel like a home you are in the right place.
about:
Southpaw Furniture Co operates from Sturtevant, Wisconsin, as a family-owned shop that began as a garage startup before expanding into a full-time manufacturing operation. The company does not disclose a founding year, but its about page describes the venture growing from a passion project into a dedicated facility.

The company handcrafts solid hardwood furniture—including custom dining tables, kitchen islands, side tables, and cabinetry—in a 5,500-square-foot facility equipped with a 400-square-foot spray booth. Multiple full-time employees build each piece using prime-grade hardwoods such as walnut and white oak, overseeing every step from design through finish application.

Southpaw serves residential and commercial customers nationwide, shipping completed pieces directly to homes and businesses. Clients collaborate on custom designs, and the shop sends physical stain samples on real wood so buyers can evaluate color in their own lighting. Reviews highlight projects ranging from dining tables to custom drawer inserts and pull-outs for kitchen islands.

The founders started the business to counter disposable furniture trends, committing to prime-grade materials and modern designs that blend form and function. The company emphasizes personalized service, sustainability, and integrity as core values, aiming to create pieces that anchor rooms for decades rather than seasons.

name: Sovereign Plastics
old_description: At Sovereign Plastics we know that defining and following structured processes is a key element in consistently delivering high quality parts.  For each of our products, we develop and maintain a Process Quality Document (PQD)...
about:
Sovereign Plastics operates from a 23,000-square-foot facility in Colorado Springs, Colorado. The company was acquired in June 2022 by TheLandersCompanies, LLC, based in Tucson, Arizona. No founding year or original founders are disclosed.

The company specializes in plastic injection molding and in-house mold making, building more than 100 molds annually in its Colorado facility. The plant houses a separate machine shop, molding machines, and space for light assembly, fulfillment, and packaging. Capabilities include short-run molding, advanced molding techniques, and a lifetime mold guarantee for as long as Sovereign runs the parts.

Sovereign serves automotive, medical, consumer, and industrial markets, producing parts for applications across those sectors. The company emphasizes long-term customer relationships and referrals.

Quality is structured around a Process Quality Document (PQD) developed for each product, capturing critical dimensions and cosmetic requirements through collaboration among engineers, technicians, and production staff. The approach aims to deliver consistent quality and retain customers for life.

name: Space Tables Inc
old_description: Space Tables is a family owned company. To us, the table is the heart of every home. Whether that home is a private residence or an assisted living facility, the table is where people come together to share a meal, share their time, and share their lives.
about:
Space Tables Inc is based in Maple Grove, Minnesota. The company traces its roots to 1976, when it was founded as a family-owned business. In 1977, the firm developed one of the first wheelchair-accessible patio tables; a customer's suggestion to focus on healthcare shaped its direction. Today it operates as a woman-owned enterprise.

The company manufactures commercial and institutional dining tables for indoor and outdoor use. Its capabilities include table base fabrication with steel columns and stamped steel legs, zinc undercoat finishes, and outdoor powder coating. Product lines encompass the Orlando Collection, Sanibel Series, Vegas Collection, and Cheyenne Series, all offered with customizable finishes and height-adjustable mechanisms.

Space Tables serves senior living communities, assisted living facilities, healthcare providers, and restaurants. Its tables are designed to support independence for residents in home care and nursing home settings, and to withstand the demands of commercial dining environments.

The company's stated mission centers on the belief that dining is a vital social event. By offering customizable, durable tables that can be raised, lowered, and moved, Space Tables aims to help caregivers provide better care and to create products that last for years without replacement.

name: Spacestor New York Design Centre
old_description: New York founded recruitment experts, Robert Half International, know how to treat their employees and have worked alongside Arch Design to fit out a workspace informed by human-centric design thinking.
about:
Spacestor operates a New York Design Centre in New York, New York, as part of a global furniture brand that began nearly three decades ago in the United Kingdom. The company was founded on a blend of California cool and London design sensibilities, though no founding year or individual founders are disclosed. Ownership details are not publicly stated.

The company manufactures modular, customizable, space-defining furniture systems including meeting spaces, pods and booths, zoning solutions, lockers, system walls, freestanding storage, tables, benches, seating, desking, and ancillary pieces. Product families such as Railway Carriage, Portals, Aeonica, Palisades, and Portico are produced in the company's own factories, supported by a global team. The database lists a headcount of 2,000, though facility size and production volumes are not specified.

Spacestor serves a wide range of industries: financial services, professional services, technology & IT, government & defense, co-working, real estate, sciences, sports media & entertainment, education, architecture & design, food & drink, manufacturing, nonprofit, publishing, retail, and travel & aviation. Long‑term clients include Google, Pfizer, and JPMorgan, while recent project work spans Essenta Partners (London), Allianz (Leeds), Dentsu (Edinburgh), Wizu Workspace (UK‑wide), BlackRock (Edinburgh), Autodesk (Atlanta), and the U.S. financial‑services client at The Star in Frisco, Texas.

The firm’s stated mission is to improve workspaces so that people spend their 90,000 working hours in environments that foster happiness, creativity, teamwork, and success. A noted differentiator is the commitment to give back approximately 10 % of revenue to local schools and charities, alongside a design philosophy that merges West Coast informality with British rigour.
